For the synthesis contract, only percentage change in body weight from baseline to week 72 is eligible; categorical weight-loss thresholds, weight in kilograms, cardiometabolic outcomes, body composition, and safety outcomes are excluded.
No pooled week-72 percentage-body-weight estimate is reported for all tirzepatide doses. The synthesis plan therefore selects the 15-mg dose-specific contrast versus placebo.
Treatment-regimen results include all randomized participants and are the primary reported results unless otherwise stated.
